apple-200676774-3956.text:
The Video Computer Vision organization is working on exciting technologies for future Apple products. Our team delivers computer vision and machine learning algorithms that power many Apple technologies like human understanding and human intelligence algorithms with applications for digital humans, health and AI. In this role, you will work closely with our team of experts in computer graphics, computer vision and machine learning to design and build solutions to previously unsolved challenges for Apple products and bring high impact to millions of users.
You will work closely with Multimodal GenAI researchers and engineers to develop world-class audio-video perception and representation algorithms. The role focuses on building, integrating and maintaining complex real-time systems within a large production software stack. Deep understanding of machine learning inference and performance oriented development is highly desirable. As a member of a fast-paced team, you have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of people every day.
The ideal candidate should possess these qualities:
* Be highly-motivated and take initiative to achieve goals, while delivering on schedule.
* Has a sense of curiosity and willingness to learn new things in order to improve the quality of their solutions.
* Works well in a collaborative setting.
Design and drive software architecture for both production systems and internal tools
Implement and optimize performance-critical algorithms for mobile and embedded platforms
Developing and integrating agentic workflow frameworks with tool calling components
Integrate multimodal models with audio, image and video modalities for efficient on-device inference
Build tooling for visualization, logging, debugging and evaluation
Integrate real-time perception, 3D representation and animation systems into a broader end-to-end software stack
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related fields.
5+ years of relevant industry experience.
Strong proficiency in C/C++ or Swift, writing clean and well-structured code.
Solid mathematical foundation in linear algebra and numerical analysis.
Experience breaking down large problems and delivering robust solutions.
Experience developing user-facing APIs for complex systems.
Curiosity about new technologies and flexibility to work across different layers of the software stack.
Preferred Qualifications
MS/PhD with relevant industry experience.
Experience with audio, computer vision, 3D graphics and animation algorithms.
Experience deploying algorithms to GPUs or other hardware accelerators.
Understanding of SW/HW parallelism, threads, processes and asynchronous processing.
iOS or macOS development experience using frameworks like Foundation Models, MLX, ARKit, REKit.
Knowledge of diffusion transformer models especially in context of on-device inference.

apple-200693226-3337.text:
The Spatial Intelligence Experiences team is looking for a senior software engineer to own and drive application and experience development in the novel intersection of Spatial Computing and Generative AI. You will leverage the latest features in the Apple Intelligence stack, pitch new ideas via prototyping, and ship highly polished user-facing features in places like Siri AI and Image Playground. With a sharp focus on reimagining AI features to bring unique value to the spatial environment, you will also work across Apple’s device ecosystem (iOS, macOS, iPadOS), collaborate with engineering, design, and QA teams to ship a consistent user experience to the end customer.
Apps and experiences are at the core of unleashing the potential of Apple's Spatial Computing Platform. In this role, you will lead development to ship customer-facing spatial computing features powered by cutting-edge AI, such as embodied conversational AI assistants and generative spatial experiences. You will own end-to-end development of the user experience, taking an idea from prototype to technical spec to shipped code. And you will achieve this by driving strong collaboration with other engineering teams (whose software your feature may depend on), as well as design and quality assurance, making sure the shipped product meets Apple's high standard of quality and polish.
Ship customer-facing spatial computing features powered by cutting-edge AI, such as embodied conversational AI assistants and generative spatial experiences.
Own features end to end with a sharp focus on UI/UX polish. Take an idea from prototype to technical spec to production code that meets Apple's high shipping standard.
Start from the user. Keep user pain points and the value the product can deliver front of mind, and bring strong product and design sense to lead through ambiguity.
Drive collaboration across teams. Work closely with the engineering teams whose software your features depend on, as well as with design and quality assurance teams.
Optimize for mobile platforms where compute and power are tightly limited. Analyze and discover new ways to optimize performance of features, so they can run smoothly and meet power and performance targets.
Work with modern AI tooling. Use LLM-assisted development tools and build effective agentic workflows to move software quickly and steadily through each release milestone.
Lead as a senior member. Work independently and proactively, build strong relationships with cross-functional partners, and help the engineering team run more efficiently.
Minimum Qualifications
BS / MS / PhD in Computer Science OR equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience owning and shipping consumer-facing applications or user experience features.
Strong Computer Science fundamentals, and strong 3D math/linear algebra fundamentals.
Proficiency in Swift, Objective-C, or C++. And familiarity with UI frameworks such as SwiftUI and UIKit.
Experience solving technical challenges across multiple layers of a software stack, such as logging and diagnosing events from application code, UI framework, system framework, and backend LLM.
Fluency with agentic development tools and workflows to accelerate coding, debugging, and testing.
Experience in collaborating with a design team to iterate on UI feature implementation and polish. Ability to clearly articulate problems and explain the trade-offs of different software solution options.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with 3D graphics APIs and/or game engines, and demonstrated experience shipping interactive 3D applications on consumer platforms (mobile/web/game consoles/VR/etc.).
Experience in driving projects or complex features as a technical lead - defining new feature architecture, aligning spec and KPI with design and performance stakeholders, coordinating with dependency engineering and QA teams to land features through release milestones.
Experience in prototyping and developing new user experiences powered by evolving LLM capabilities, e.g. a new use case of generative imagery that drives new capabilities of an underlying diffusion model.
Experience in optimizing software running on mobile platforms, with goals to achieve demanding targets of power and performance.
Familiarity with AI feature development, such as prompting, model fine-tuning and evaluation.

At Apple, we focus deeply on our customers’ experience. Apple Ads brings this same approach to advertising, helping people find exactly what they’re looking for and helping advertisers grow their businesses! Our technology powers ads and sponsorships across Apple Services, including the App Store, Apple News, and MLS Season Pass.
Everything we do is designed for trust, connection, and impact: We respect user privacy, integrate advertising thoughtfully into the experience, and deliver value for advertisers of all sizes—from small app developers to big, global brands. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone!
You'll have the opportunity to develop models that improve our platform across the board, write production code to generate recommendations, work closely with business partners to help drive the development of new products as well as perform large scale and complex experiments to understand their effects. You'll drive strategic outcomes through substantial innovation in multiple fields by leading the development and application of advanced techniques and algorithms to improve our ad network.
You've, or will develop a deep understanding of the ad network behavior, and will work with product management and business leadership to prioritize an innovation roadmap across multiple technical domains. You'll lead the conception, development, and delivery of state of the art capabilities that differentiate our products and are core to our business. You should have experience developing and implementing machine learning algorithms, ideally within the ads space. You'll have an excellent understanding of scalable architectures and thrive working in Agile environments. The ability to be a good team player under tight deadline constraints is key to success.
Matching at Ads is a critical component of our Ads funnel and responsible for ensuring that we are retrieving relevant and engaging Ads for our users. We are building the next generation of our retrieval systems to sustain the growth of the business for the future. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer that will develop the algorithms for our retrieval system.
In this role you will drive step-change improvements in our outcomes, impact our platform revenue and quality of our ads, and formulate approaches to greenfield product opportunities. You will own end-to-end the ideation, development, testing and productization of these algorithms. You will work with complex problems in the ads retrieval space, provide solution that adhere to Apple’s privacy principles, review and contribute to state of the art in research, work with a variety of cross functional teams to ensure the feasibility and robustness of delivering new capabilities. This role will work closely with organizational partners and be expected to present findings across the organization.
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years of experience building machine learning capabilities across many different product areas at scale.
Proven experience in NLP, information retrieval and search.
Ability to apply and implement research concepts, ultimately in production quality code.
Experience defining clear, testable research hypotheses, including intended impact on the business.
Deep understanding of design of experiments, online experimentation approaches, preferably at scale.
Experience contributing and/or reviewing research for top conferences and publications.
Master's, or equivalent experience, in NLP, Machine Learning, Statistics, Forecasting, Optimization, Reinforcement Learning or related field with experience building production systems or have equivalent experience working with large data science / machine learning projects in industry.
Preferred Qualifications
PhD, or equivalent experience, in NLP, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Large Language Model, Reinforcement Learning or related field with experience building production systems or have equivalent experience working with large data science / machine learning projects in industry.

apple-200666022-0157.text:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.
IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.
Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe.
Customer Systems is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's customer support experience — from contact center operations to the software powering the iconic Genius Bar. The team also builds and operates AppleCare's online support platform, which handles 6 billion visits per year, delivering seamless, high-quality support to Apple customers around the globe. Design and build microservices powering low-latency, high-throughput customer experiences — serving over a million users daily across Apple Support websites, iOS apps, and phone-based frontends.
Own end-to-end delivery of features — from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production observability.
Drive engineering best practices — code reviews, unit/integration testing, CI/CD pipeline improvements, and documentation — raising the bar for the broader team.
Architect non-blocking, event-driven service pipelines that handle millions of concurrent requests with resilience and back-pressure management.
Contribute to API design and contract-first development, ensuring backward compatibility and clean integration across service boundaries.
Minimum Qualifications
B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional work experience.
5+ years proven experience developing software in a professional capacity. Longer experience preferred.
2+ years proven experience with Java, including proficiency in concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization techniques.
Proficiency in OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code.
Experience building production applications with the Spring ecosystem (e.g. Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, etc.), including proficiency in dependency injection, auto-configuration, reactive programming with WebFlux, and designing microservices using Spring-based patterns.
Solid understanding of advanced JVM internals (e.g. garbage collection, memory allocation, JIT, JNI, etc.).
Experience designing, implementing, and shipping high-scale, high-performance, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure cloud-based distributed systems.
Solid knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and infrastructure (e.g. HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, CDN, load balancing, edge computing, DNS, Zero Trust architecture, etc.).
Preferred Qualifications
Track record of leading software projects within a team as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring software engineers.
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes.
Experience with complementary programming languages beyond Java (e.g. Go, Python, Ruby, etc.), including practical use for automation scripting, infrastructure tooling, data processing pipelines, and build system customizations.
Experience in API design and implementation, including proficiency in RESTful API principles, gRPC, GraphQL, contract-first design (e.g. OpenAPI/Swagger, Protobuf, etc.), API versioning strategies, gateway patterns, rate limiting, and designing APIs for backward compatibility and long-term evolution.
Experience with caching strategies and in-memory data technologies (e.g. Redis, Memcached, Hazelcast, Ehcache, etc.), including proficiency in cache invalidation patterns, distributed caching architectures, and session management for high-throughput applications.

A passion for creating effective and pragmatic cryptographic implementations

apple-200692937-3956.text:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.
Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.
On Marcom Engineering's AI Experiences team, we build AI-powered tools for Apple's marketing and creative teams, from AI-assisted copy workflows to AI Optimization (AIO), along with the AI foundations that help our engineers, and the AI agents working alongside them, ship on-brand work faster.
We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the AI-powered tools our marketing and creative teams use every day, and the AI foundations that change how our engineers ship. You will own features end to end — from interfaces that stream, structure, and explain AI-generated content, to the tooling that helps coding agents build with our design system correctly and on brand. This role sits at the intersection of frontend engineering and applied AI: you'll turn the team's AI direction into shipped work, define the schemas that connect models to UI, and guide the engineers building alongside you. If you thrive on ambiguity, care deeply about user experience, and want to shape how people interact with intelligent systems, we want to hear from you.
Build AI-powered interfaces: Design, implement, and ship production-ready React applications for AI-driven tools — streaming responses, structured outputs, conversational flows, and human-in-the-loop review — for the marketing and creative teams who rely on them.
Define interaction schemas: Collaborate with AI/ML and backend teams to define the data contracts, response formats, and structured output schemas that bridge model capabilities and frontend rendering.
Find new solutions: Prototype and iterate on novel UI patterns for AI interactions — real-time streaming, progressive disclosure of model reasoning, tool-use feedback, and review-and-approve workflows.
Build the AI foundations: Build and maintain the tooling that brings AI into how we engineer — AI-assisted code review, release automation, and reusable agent skills in CI/CD — and the agent-facing interfaces (MCP servers, agent-friendly CLIs, machine-readable component metadata) that help coding agents use our design system correctly and on brand.
Own outcomes: Lead the projects you own from technical design through deployment and iteration, shipping on schedule and improving based on user feedback, usage data, and evaluation results.
Raise the bar: Lead code reviews, establish best practices for AI-facing frontend development, and create documentation and training on topics like streaming architectures, schema validation, and graceful degradation. Champion healthy adoption of AI-assisted development across the team.
Minimum Qualifications
5 years using TypeScript, React, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3 in production applications, including responsive layouts
2 years building interfaces that consume AI/ML model outputs (e.g., LLM responses, structured generation, streaming APIs, or real-time inference results)
Experience with real-time data handling — streaming protocols (SSE, WebSockets, NDJSON/JSONL), incremental rendering, or progressive content delivery
Experience defining or consuming structured schemas and data contracts (e.g., GraphQL, including federated graphs; JSON Schema; OpenAPI; or TypeBox)
Experience with application performance optimization techniques or caching solutions
Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and building inclusive interfaces
Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in daily development, with sound judgment in reviewing and integrating generated code
BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building conversational or chat-based UIs with streaming LLM responses
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts: prompt engineering, tool use / function calling, structured outputs, embeddings, or RAG architectures
Experience building agent-facing tooling, such as MCP servers, CLIs designed for agents, or packaged agent skills and instructions
Experience bringing AI into CI/CD workflows, such as AI-assisted code review, automated release notes, or AI-driven quality gates
Familiarity with evaluating AI output — evals, golden datasets, or LLM-as-judge scoring
Experience with design systems, component libraries, or design tokens
Experience with Next.js (server-side rendering), Node.js, Sass/CSS Modules, Vite, Vitest, Playwright, and Storybook, or similar tools
Effective communicator who can work across both technical and creative teams
Experience working in environments with ambiguity — defining the shape of a product as the underlying AI capabilities evolve
